short_description: Premium DDR5-6000 dual-channel RAM kit with RGB lighting for gaming & high-performance PCs.
key_features: RGB lighting, high speed 6000 MHz, tight CL36 timings, premium heat spreader, XMP support, dual-channel kit.
long_description: The G.Skill Trident Z5 RGB series represents G.Skill’s flagship DDR5 memory designed for next-gen platforms. This 32 GB (2×16 GB) kit runs at 6000 MHz with CL36 timings and features a sleek, dual-texture aluminum heat spreader with customizable RGB. Engineered for gamers, content creators, and performance builders, it supports Intel XMP profiles for easy performance tuning and extreme overclocking. Reliability and compatibility are validated across the latest Intel and AMD DDR5 platforms.

short_description: Single 32 GB DDR5-5200MHz memory module with CL40 latency.
key_features: 32GB capacity, 5200 MHz speed, CL40 timing, DDR5, compact heat spreader.
long_description: The Corsair Vengeance 32GB (1×32GB) DDR5-5200C40 desktop memory is a high-capacity DDR5 module optimized for modern platforms. Running at 5200 MHz with CL40 timings, it offers responsive performance for productivity, multitasking, and gaming systems. It features Intel XMP 3.0 profile support for easy tuning and Corsair’s reliable build quality with robust heat spreader design. Ideal for users who want a large-capacity single stick upgrade path with stable performance.

short_description: 16GB single-stick DDR5-5200MHz RGB module with PMIC and ECC.
key_features: RGB lighting, power management IC (PMIC), on-die ECC, Intel XMP/AMD EXPO support.
long_description: The ADATA XPG Lancer RGB 16GB DDR5-5200MHz RAM is a gaming-oriented memory module with integrated RGB lighting, delivering stable performance at 5200 MHz and CL38 timings. It includes a PMIC for improved power delivery and on-die ECC for enhanced reliability — typical of DDR5 designs. Compatible with modern Intel and AMD platforms, it supports Intel XMP 3.0 and AMD EXPO profiles for easy performance tuning.

short_description: 16GB single-module DDR4-3200 C16 RAM with low-profile heat spreader.
key_features: High-speed DDR4, tight CL16 latency, low-profile aluminum heat spreader, XMP 2.0 support
long_description: Corsair Vengeance LPX is a performance-oriented DDR4 memory module designed for gaming, multitasking, and mainstream desktops. This 16GB (1×16GB) 3200MHz module (CMK16GX4M1E3200C16) features a low-profile anodized aluminum heat spreader for efficient heat dissipation during extended use and supports Intel XMP 2.0 for easy performance tuning in supported systems. Compatible with most DDR4 motherboards, it offers reliable operation and solid performance for everyday computing and gaming workloads.

short_description: Dual-channel 16 GB (2×8 GB) DDR4-3600MHz RAM with CL16 timing, ideal for gaming and performance builds.
key_features: 3600 MHz speed, CL16 latency, Intel XMP 2.0 support, dual-channel memory kit, tested compatibility with DDR4 platforms.
long_description: The G.Skill Ripjaws V 16GB (2×8GB) DDR4-3600MHz memory kit is a high-performance desktop RAM solution designed for gamers, enthusiasts, and content creators. With a tested speed of 3600 MHz and tight CL16-19-19-39 timings at 1.35 V, it delivers responsive performance for gaming, multitasking, and productivity workflows. The dual-channel configuration maximizes bandwidth on modern Intel and AMD platforms, while Intel XMP 2.0 support enables easy BIOS tuning. G.Skill’s rigorous testing ensures wide motherboard compatibility and reliability.
